given: One SKU holds stock at two different locations (two records sharing the SKU)
when: The team member opens the home stock table
then: Both (sku, location) records appear as two separate rows, not collapsed into a single per-SKU row

independence.rationale: Asserts that stock is addressed per (sku, location) in the browse view (one SKU at two locations yields two rows), distinct from AC1 which uses different SKUs; a build could pass AC1 yet collapse same-SKU rows and lose a location.
